what: A sharp triangular color face over a photo unfolds from its centroid, one vertex at a time (each vertex .14s expo.out). Hovering opens it, and releasing folds it back to a single point in reverse at .7× the length — releasing mid-unfold does not cut it off, it retracts after fully opening. With ”view,” it unfolds once, 100ms after 24% of it has entered the screen.

options.points: Vertex percentages “x,y,x,y,x,y…” — three or more. Can also be set as the child shape’s data-points
options.on: hover (opens on hover, closes on release)·view (once when it enters the screen, default)·load (once immediately)
options.with: Vertex numbers (from 0, comma separated) that extend together with the front vertex — the main photo of the square shadow type is 3
options.delay: Time from appearing until unfolding (ms), default 100
options.margin: Visibility rootMargin — default 0px, the original hero photo uses ”0px 0px -15% 0px” · at 0
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Color plane to unfold (child) — slotted between the photo front and back so the person in the photo stands in front of the plane
options.[data-fx-part=hit]: on: child that receives the interaction on hover (card link) — the element itself if none

from.where: index.html · list.html .kk-person (person card — the triangle unfolds on hover) · .kk-story (case row — 100ms after 24% is visible) · .kk-ceo (CEO photo — four corners, with: 3, margin: 0px 0px -15% 0px) · hero of detail.html · article.html (load)
